camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --ActiveAddressType Public --DatabaseType MySQL --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-7mz2g5hu20e' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Source Local
description_en: Imports database assets into a bastion host. Supported database types include MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL for ApsaraDB RDS instances, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle) for PolarDB clusters, and MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle for self-managed databases
description_zh: 您可以通过本接口，将MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL类型的RDS和MySQL、PostgreSQL、PostgreSQL（兼容Oracle）的PolarDB以及MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、Oracle类型的自建数据库资产导入至堡垒机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-database --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2g5hu20e --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-type MySQL --active-address-type Public --source Local --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to which the new database belongs.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库所属的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the new database. Valid values:

Public: public address
Private: private network address
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库的地址类型。取值：

Public：公网地址
Private：私网地址
parameters.name: active_address_type

parameters.help_en:
The private network address. IPv4 addresses and domain name formats are supported.
This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Private
parameters.help_zh:
私网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式。
ActiveAddressType选择Private时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_private_address

parameters.help_en:
The public address. IPv4 addresses and domain name formats are supported.
This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Public
parameters.help_zh:
公网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式。
ActiveAddressType选择Public时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_public_address

parameters.help_en: The port used to access the database. This parameter is required when the database source is Local
parameters.help_zh: 数据库的访问端口。数据库来源为Local，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the new database instance. This parameter is required when the database source is Local
parameters.help_zh: 新创建的数据库实例名称。数据库来源为Local，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the new database.  
This parameter is required when Source is set to Rds or PolarDB
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的数据库实例ID。  
Source选择Rds或PolarDB时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the new database. Valid values:
Local: self-managed database instance
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
PolarDB: PolarDB cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库的来源。取值：
Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the new database. The value can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的数据库的备注信息。最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the new database instance.
This parameter is required when Source is set to Rds or PolarDB
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的数据库实例所属地域ID。
Source为Rds或PolarDB时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint type of the PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required when Source is set to PolarDB. Valid values:
Cluster: cluster endpoint
Primary: primary endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
Source为PolarDB时必传，表示PolarDB的Endpoint类型，取值：
Cluster：集群地址
Primary：主地址
parameters.name: polar_db_endpoint_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the new ApsaraDB RDS or PolarDB database instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的RDS、PolarDB数据库实例所属的主账号ID
parameters.name: instance_member_id

DatabaseId.description_en: The instance ID of the database

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
